sources.title: GitHub - nex-agi/Nex-N2.5 · GitHub
sources.snippet: Today, Nex-AGI officially introduces Nex-N2.5, its next-generation family of agentic models. Nex-N2.5 is available in three sizes: mini, Pro, and Max. Nex-N2.5-mini and Nex-N2.5-Pro continue to build on the multimodal foundations of Nex-N2, with focused improvements in computer use, web browsing, and visually grounded agentic capabilities.
